test_title: SSC CGL 2022 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On : 09 Dec 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: The ceremony that marks the end of Republic Day celebrations is ________.

options.text: the fly-past by the Indian Air Force fighter aircraft
the ‘At Home’ ceremony at Rashtrapati Bhawan
the homage ceremony at National War Memorial

solution:
The correct answer is __**the beating retreat ceremony**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Beating Retreat Ceremony** is a military ceremony dating back to 17th-century England.
 
• The Beating Retreat Ceremony was originally known as **‘Watch Setting’**.
 
• This Ceremony was first used to recall nearby** patrolling units to their castle.**
 
• It was initiated at sunset by the firing of a single round from the evening gun.
 
• The Beating Retreat Ceremonies usually consist of firing a canon, marching a band, and other decorative presentations.
 
• Currently, most of the armed forces in the ‘Commonwealth’ perform some ceremonial form of retreat. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• According to **Wing Commander Indranil Nandi**, the Republic Day fly-past will feature 45 Indian Air Force (IAF) aircraft, one Indian Navy aircraft, and four Indian Army helicopters.
 
• **At Home’ ceremony at Rashtrapati Bhawan**, It is an opportunity for people from various walks to meet the PM (Prime Minister) and the President and to interact with each other.
 
• PM Modi pays tribute to fallen soldiers at **National War Memorial** on Republic Day.
